film: Comedy, Music, and the Illusion of Self

shots.action: Closed laptop. Title 'where is the laptop?' fades in.
Screen rises open. One real movement.
Wave explode: battery, board, chips, deck, keys, screen cascade upward.
6 gold labels draw: display, keyboard, top case, logic board, battery, bottom case.
Parts ghost to 18% opacity. The word 'laptop' hangs solid center.
Snap reassemble. Title out. Match-cut to s1 framing.

notes: Transition rule: hard cuts for beats, dissolves for ontology only. Labels gold #f5c76b. Violation red #e8102e.
